summary: Tested the maintenance backend and UI, the upload demo-video gate, the homepage exploded report and 3D measures (desktop and mobile), the hero on mobile, the preloader, the About page and footer, PDF v4.0 and the bowling weight-transfer score. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed. Frontend: most flows work. Found 3 issues: (1) dragging the demo video to the end unlocks the upload without watching it; (2) the admin Maintenance form shows stale values right after saving; (3) unhandled 503 errors while the maintenance gate is still loading. Maintenance was left OFF (GET /api/plans returns 200).

minor.issue: '/api/auth/' is fully open during maintenance, so players can still sign up, log in and reset passwords; only the other APIs return 503. This is acceptable, but note it. '/api/maintenance' is a prefix match, so any future route that starts with '/api/maintenance...' would skip the gate.
The cache is per process with a 10s TTL. With several uvicorn workers, a PUT only clears the cache of the worker that handled it, so other workers can lag by up to 10s. This is fine as documented.

ui_bugs.issue: You can skip the demo by moving the video to its end (setting currentTime = duration, the same as dragging the scrubber to the end). The 'ended' event fires, onEnded calls onWatched with no check, and the dropzone appears. Seeking to the middle is blocked correctly. Fix: in onEnded, only call onWatched if maxT.current >= duration - 0.5. Better: also add an onSeeking handler that snaps back to maxT, and lock playbackRate to 1 (onRateChange).

After 'Save schedule', the badge correctly shows 'Scheduled', but the form resets to the OLD values: empty start and end, switch OFF, default message. Cause: save() calls setF(null) and then load(). The useEffect `if (m && !f) setF(...)` runs straight away with the stale m, before load() resolves. If the admin clicks Save again, the schedule is silently disabled. Fix: build f from the PUT response data (setF(fromM(data))), or call setF(null) only after load() resolves.

integration_issues.flow: MaintenanceGate while maintenance is active (logged-in player)
integration_issues.issue: MaintenanceGate renders children while m === null, before /api/maintenance resolves (`if (!m?.active || loading) return children`). App pages mount and call APIs that return 503. Upload.loadStatus has no .catch, so you get an 'Unhandled rejection: Request failed with status code 503' (shown by the Emergent overlay on /app/upload). Fix: render a blank or loader screen while m === null, and add a .catch to loadStatus.

issues: Start and end use the browser's native datetime-local picker instead of the shadcn calendar plus a time input
The copy says 'Scroll to pull the report apart', but mobile shows a plain card list with no pull-apart effect

The right column has a lot of empty space under the detail card and the 6-item grid, next to the 520px-tall canvas. Measure points move slightly with the model; Playwright reports them as unstable, but real clicks work.

action_items: DemoVideo: guard onEnded with a max-watched-time check, and block seeking to the end and playbackRate changes
MaintenanceAdmin: after a successful save, fill the form from the saved response instead of the stale m
MaintenanceGate: don't render children before the maintenance status has loaded; add .catch to Upload loadStatus and other bare api.get calls
critical_code_review_comments: Maintenance.jsx save(): the setF(null) + load() race shows stale data in the form (see ui_bugs)
AppMain.jsx Upload: loadStatus has no error handling. A 503 or any other error leaves the page stuck on 'Loading…' with an unhandled rejection.
The demo-watched flag lives only in localStorage, so the client can bypass it. This is acceptable for a UX nudge, but it is not enforced on the server.
seed_data_creation: None. Maintenance settings were toggled during the tests and finally set to enabled:false with null times (verified: GET /api/plans returns 200, /api/maintenance returns active:false).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use `python /app/backend/tests/maint_toggle.py on|off` to toggle a live maintenance window, and always run 'off' at the end. Bowling PDF job: 4b50454e0476462fb9977ea2402a175d (owned by the super admin; QA admin can fetch it). PDF text check uses pymupdf (pypdf isn't installed). Run pytest with `-n 0` if needed. Upload gate: clear localStorage demo_watched; the demos are about 4.04s long.
rca of the issue: Demo bypass: onEnded={onWatched} has no check; seeking to the end fires 'ended' before onTimeUpdate can snap back. Admin form stale: the effect re-initialises f from the old m as soon as f becomes null. Unhandled 503: the gate renders the app before the maintenance status has loaded.
